_note: Entry ids whose picture is a FILE COMMITTED TO THIS REPO under public/gear/,
not something tools/fetch-images.mjs downloads. Nobody publishes these, so
Keep this list in step with what is actually in public/gear/ and has no key
in gear-sources.json. tools/gen-icons.mjs unions the two to build
src/data/icons.ts, and tools/check-mirrors.mjs subtracts these so a full
mirror does not report itself short.
OPERATORS — sixteen portraits, cut out and squared to the same framing.
Spellings corrected on the way in: gismo -> gizmo, shepered -> shepherd,
synerva -> sineva, toxic -> toxik, morce -> morse, vlynder -> vlinder. The
file labelled H0 is filed as n-two by elimination: it was one of three raw
portraits supplied for the three operators still missing one, and the other
two name themselves. Worth a second look if N-Two's face looks wrong.
src/data/deltaforce.ts is the authority for how an entry is named.
MAPS — five cropped from the world map screen. az3 is cut from the same
screen out of a video frame, at the framing the other five share: a ~180px
square centred 56px below the label. zero-dam-night is the day icon graded
down, because the night raid is the same dam and has no separate marker.
